POPULAR TOURNAMENTS
Americano: Americano is a popular tournament format in padel where players compete in teams of two. It follows a round-robin format, where each team plays against every other team in the tournament. The team with the highest number of wins emerges as the champion. This format guarantees intense and exciting matches throughout the tournament.

Mexicano: Mexicano is a thrilling padel tournament format that combines elements of singles and doubles play. Each team consists of three players, and matches are played in a rotating format. The three players take turns playing singles matches against the opposing team, resulting in a dynamic and strategic gameplay experience. Mexicano offers a unique twist to traditional padel tournaments.

Mixicano: Mixicano is a fun and inclusive padel tournament format that promotes gender diversity and teamwork. It is a mixed doubles tournament where each team consists of one male and one female player. Mixicano tournaments encourage players of all skill levels to participate and enjoy the sport together. With its emphasis on balance and cooperation, Mixicano creates an engaging and supportive atmosphere for players.

NUMBER OF PARTICIPANTS
Our app is designed to accommodate any number of players, unlike other apps in the market. We specialize in creating a tournament generator that can effectively manage varying player counts, whether it's low, high, or uneven.

THE SCORING SYSTEM
Based on a predetermined number of points per game (e.g. 21 points) the team that takes the most number of points will be the winner of the match. This also means that being the winner or loser of the match is irrelevant. The reason for this is that each point counts in your individual results. As a player you should always aim to get as many points as possible, it will not be the same to win 20 to 1 than 11 to 10.
